args.title: Honor Accept-Language q-values when picking locale
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

pickLocale() currently returns the first supported locale in header order, ignoring the `;q=` quality weights. It should parse each entry's q value and pick the supported locale with the highest weight, so a header like 'en;q=0.3, fr-FR;q=0.9' correctly resolves to French instead of English.

args.title: Return non-200 HTTP status for degraded health checks
args.body:
File: src/api/health.ts

The readiness handler currently only returns HTTP 503 when status is "down", so a "degraded" queue (depth > QUEUE_DEGRADED_AT) still yields HTTP 200. Update the status-to-HTTP-code mapping so "degraded" also returns a non-200 (or otherwise distinct) response, so load-balancer probes can take the instance out of rotation.

args.title: Reject non-numeric suffixes in config int() parsing
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

The int() helper uses Number.parseInt(raw, 10) and only checks Number.isNaN(value), so values like "12h" or "1h" are silently truncated to 12 or 1 instead of failing. Replace the parsing with a strict check (e.g. Number(raw) or a regex) so trailing non-numeric characters cause a thrown error, fixing this for TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES and RESET_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES.
